title: CountVideoBench: A Benchmark to Evaluate Prediction Biases on the Object Counting task by Video-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object counting in videos remains a poorly characterized capability of multimodal large language models. Counting questions are included in many existing VideoQA benchmarks, but the ground-truth count distributions in these benchmarks are heavily skewed toward small values. Across the nine benchmarks we survey, the median ground-truth count is at most five, and the three most frequent values together account for between 45% and 93% of the videos. The resulting mean accuracy is then dominated by the most frequent counts; a value-dependent bias at a rare count contributes negligibly to the average and remains invisible. We introduce CountVideoBench, a benchmark of 2,600 synthetic videos covering 26 cardinalities in the interval [5, 50] (100 videos each), grouped into six clusters of consecutive counts that span the range while enabling near-neighbor comparisons. translated_title: CountVideoBench：一个用于评估视频语言模型在物体计数任务上预测偏差的基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28356v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：视频中的物体计数仍然是多模态大语言模型一项刻画不足的能力。许多现有的视频问答（VideoQA）基准中包含计数问题，但这些基准中的真实计数值分布严重偏向小数值。在我们调查的九个基准中，真实计数的中位数至多为5，且出现频率最高的三个数值合计占视频总数的45%至93%。因此，平均准确率主要由最常见的计数值主导；在罕见计数值上出现的依赖数值的偏差对平均值的贡献微乎其微，因而无法被察觉。我们提出了CountVideoBench，这是一个包含2,600个合成视频的基准，覆盖[5, 50]区间内的26个计数值（每个数值100个视频），并被分为六个由连续计数组成的聚类，既覆盖整个数值范围，又能支持近邻数值间的比较。每个视频在受控的摄像条件下包含单一类别的静态物体。
tldr: 该论文提出CountVideoBench基准，利用2,600个覆盖[5,50]区间内26个计数值的合成视频，解决了现有视频问答基准计数分布严重偏向小数值、导致大数值上的模型预测偏差无法被评估的问题，从而系统性地评估视频语言模型在物体计数任务中的预测偏差。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CountVideoBench, a benchmark of 2,600 synthetic videos covering 26 cardinalities in the range [5, 50], to address the skew toward small counts in existing VideoQA benchmarks that hides value-dependent prediction biases, thereby systematically evaluating the object counting performance of video-language models.
